description.value:
Perhaps your parents or a distant ancestor performed a great service for one of the Lords of the Tane. Perhaps you resemble a powerful fey noble's long-lost love. Whatever the occasion, you've been blessed from a young age by the Starlit Crown of the First World. They've bestowed upon you a sign that serves as a passport and protection when you wander into the First World. In the Universe, when you're excited, your eyes shine like stars, your skin seems to glow like evening moonlight, or your hair or scales shine golden as the sun. When walking the First World, your inner light protects you and informs would-be predators that you have a powerful patron. But one day, whoever bestowed this blessing upon you might call upon you for a favor.

Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Wisdom or Charisma, and one is a free attribute boost.

You're trained in the Occultism skill and the Fey Lore skill. Once per day, you can cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.Revealing Light] as an occult innate spell.
